request: 2011-W48 相比 2011-W47，净销售额变化了多少？给出两周的净销售额、差额（W48 减 W47）和变化率。
sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT week,
         SUM(CASE WHEN line_type = '销售' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv,
         SUM(CASE WHEN line_type = '取消' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_amt,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN line_type = '销售' THEN invoice END) AS orders,
         COUNT(*) AS lines,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN line_type = '销售' THEN order_date END) AS sale_days
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE week IN ('2011-W47', '2011-W48')
  GROUP BY week
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN round(gmv, 2) END)            AS gmv_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN round(cancel_amt, 2) END)      AS cancel_amt_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN round(gmv - cancel_amt, 2) END) AS net_sales_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN orders END)                    AS orders_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN lines END)                      AS lines_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN sale_days END)                  AS sale_days_2011w47,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN round(gmv, 2) END)            AS gmv_2011w48,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN round(cancel_amt, 2) END)      AS cancel_amt_2011w48,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN round(gmv - cancel_amt, 2) END) AS net_sales_2011w48,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN orders END)                    AS orders_2011w48,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN lines END)                      AS lines_2011w48,
  MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN sale_days END)                  AS sale_days_2011w48,
  round(MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN gmv - cancel_amt END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN gmv - cancel_amt END), 2) AS net_sales_diff_w48_minus_w47,
  round((MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W48' THEN gmv - cancel_amt END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN gmv - cancel_amt END))
      / MAX(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W47' THEN gmv - cancel_amt END), 4) AS net_sales_change_rate
FROM agg

columns.name: cancel_amt_2011w47
columns.meaning: 2011-W47 取消单金额合计（英镑，正数）

columns.name: net_sales_2011w47
columns.meaning: 2011-W47 净销售额 = GMV − 取消金额（英镑）

columns.name: orders_2011w47
columns.meaning: 2011-W47 销售订单数（不同销售发票号个数）

columns.name: cancel_amt_2011w48
columns.meaning: 2011-W48 取消单金额合计（英镑，正数）

columns.name: net_sales_2011w48
columns.meaning: 2011-W48 净销售额 = GMV − 取消金额（英镑）

columns.name: orders_2011w48
columns.meaning: 2011-W48 销售订单数（不同销售发票号个数）

columns.name: net_sales_diff_w48_minus_w47
columns.meaning: 净销售额差额 = 2011-W48 净销售额 − 2011-W47 净销售额（英镑）

columns.name: net_sales_change_rate
columns.meaning: 净销售额变化率 = 差额 ÷ 2011-W47 净销售额（小数，0.0369 表示 +3.69%）

definition: 口径：GMV = line_type='销售' 的 amount 合计（下单口径，含随后被取消的订单）；取消金额 = line_type='取消' 的 amount 合计（正数，取消按发生当周入账，不回溯原周）；净销售额 = GMV − 取消金额。时间范围：week 列取 '2011-W47' 与 '2011-W48'（ISO 周，对应日期 2011-11-21~11-27 与 2011-11-28~12-04，均为完整周）。订单数 = 销售行中不同 invoice 的个数（不重复计数）。差额 = W48 净销售额 − W47 净销售额；变化率 = 差额 ÷ W47 净销售额，结果为单行。
caveats: week 列中 2011-W48 对应 2011-11-28~12-04，2011-W49 才是被截断的末周（数据止于 2011-12-09 周五），因此这两周都是完整周，可直接比较。
两周各有 6 个有销售的日期（周日无销售），口径一致；W48 订单数（663）多于 W47（616），但行数略少，说明单均行数下降。
这两周内没有超大金额发票（单发票金额均 < 2 万英镑），未受极端大单扭曲。
净销售额的上升同时来自 GMV 小幅增加和取消金额下降；单周数据波动较大，差异未必代表趋势。
